claims: C1 an instruction is superseded when a later message at the same level contradicts it
C2 an instruction is superseded when a later message at the same level overrides it
C3 an instruction is superseded when a later message at the same level otherwise makes it irrelevant, e.g. by changing the context of the request

concepts.name: superseded_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that a later instruction at the same authority level has made irrelevant, by contradicting, overriding, or otherwise changing the context of the request

concepts.name: applicable_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that applies to the current request, as determined by filtering candidate instructions

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the highest authority level in the hierarchy, assigned to Model Spec 'root' sections

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: authority level L1 is higher than authority level L2 in the ranking root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority

concepts.name: instruction_message
concepts.gloss: instruction I was issued in message M
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of instructions in messages, so each instruction must be tied to the message that carries it

concepts.name: later_message
concepts.gloss: message M1 occurs later in the conversation than message M2
concepts.inference: the clause's 'later message' comparison requires an ordering over messages

concepts.name: instruction_level
concepts.gloss: instruction I was issued at authority level L
concepts.inference: the clause's 'same level' comparison requires each instruction to carry an authority level

concepts.name: contradicts
concepts.inference: the clause names contradiction as one way a later instruction supersedes an earlier one

concepts.name: overrides
concepts.inference: the clause names overriding as one way a later instruction supersedes an earlier one

concepts.name: makes_irrelevant
concepts.gloss: instruction I1 makes instruction I2 irrelevant, e.g. by changing the context of the request
concepts.inference: the clause names irrelevance as one way a later instruction supersedes an earlier one

ontology.gloss: I is superseded because a later instruction J at the same level contradicts it
ontology.body: applicable_instruction(I), instruction_message(I, M1), instruction_level(I, L), instruction_message(J, M2), instruction_level(J, L), later_message(M2, M1), contradicts(J, I)

ontology.gloss: I is superseded because a later instruction J at the same level overrides it
ontology.body: applicable_instruction(I), instruction_message(I, M1), instruction_level(I, L), instruction_message(J, M2), instruction_level(J, L), later_message(M2, M1), overrides(J, I)

ontology.gloss: I is superseded because a later instruction J at the same level makes it irrelevant
ontology.body: applicable_instruction(I), instruction_message(I, M1), instruction_level(I, L), instruction_message(J, M2), instruction_level(J, L), later_message(M2, M1), makes_irrelevant(J, I)
